Bihar News: bihar vidhan parishad ke bharti prakriya men dhandhli par bara apdet! | Breaking | Bihar News
Bihar vidhan parishad men sat padon par huee sidhi bharti prakriya men bahut bari dhandhli ki aashanka jatayi ja rahi hai...phainal rijalt men saphal ghoshit sabhi sat abhyarthiyon ko dobara shortahaind dakshata janch ke lie bulaya gaya tha.. lekin dobara test dene ek bhi chaynit abhyarthi nahin pahunche
Bihar aur jharkhand ke taza khabron ke lie dekhte rahie News18 Bihar/Jharkhand
